playerSpeed.name: Kecepatan Shuri
playerSpeed.description: How fast Shuri runs and dashes, on top of the skin's own speed bonus.

skillCooldown.name: Jeda skill
skillCooldown.description: Multiplies every skin's skill cooldown. Lower lets skills fire more often.

kuroSpeed.name: Kecepatan Kuro
kuroSpeed.description: How fast Kuro flies out when thrown.

kuroRange.name: Jangkauan Kuro
kuroRange.description: How many tiles Kuro travels before it turns back.

enemyHp.name: Darah monster
enemyHp.description: Multiplies every monster's health. Higher makes areas slower and harder.

cameraZoom.name: Zoom kamera
cameraZoom.description: Lower shows more of the area around Shuri; higher brings the camera closer.

sfxVolume.name: Efek suara
sfxVolume.description: Volume of throws, hits and other effects.

showHitboxes.name: Tampilkan hitbox
showHitboxes.description: Draws the collision boxes of Shuri, monsters and the boss.
